title: The Promise of the Old Mill House
author: Felix Coldharbour
blurb: Astrid Galloway, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
